segments.refined_text: Similarly, the quoted string "cube net ease" should remain exactly as quoted when we discuss the original STT output. It is not a request to rewrite the quote.
We need to preserve the feature flag name enable_new_ledger, the environment variable PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL, and the header X-Idempotency-Key exactly. Those identifiers are case-sensitive.
There is a 2 GB Kafka topic retention setting in staging and 14 days in production. We are considering 30 days for production, but that is not approved.
The database migration itself should be backward compatible for at least two application releases. We cannot deploy the schema change and application change as one irreversible step.
For rollback, the application image is version v2.14.3 and the migration plan has explicit expand and contract phases. We should not roll back a destructive contract migration automatically.
